notes: Whole independently placed south roofed block inside Pavilion 9 of the Litoral Penitentiary. All original full-precision numerical roof controls, complete walls and closed roof. The pavilion compound includes yards and multiple other buildings; those are not filled or substituted by this block. All imagery unused. Qualla-first corpus contains only an unrelated architectural-reference portrait. Structured Overture building coordinates and numerical height samples establish this roofed body; original SNAI 2023 report describes repairs of Pavilions 6 and 7 elsewhere on site; those repair facts are not assigned to Pavilion 9. This block’s exterior details are conservative estimates. Exact height is a learned estimate, not survey: median 6 m, at least 3 m uncertainty. Floor census, facade, roof section, paint, small detail and precise 2023 condition are estimates. No photograph, satellite image, map image, plan, figure or texture fetched or viewed.
